source: USGS/USFWS North American Bird Banding Program (NABBP), 2025 data request
notes: Pre-filtered from the full ~13GB NABBP release (57 files, all species since the 1960s) down to the 9 species_id values in recommended_h5n1_high_risk_species.csv (Mallard, Canada Goose, Wood Duck, Large Canada Goose, Blue-winged Teal, Green-winged Teal, Northern Pintail, Lesser Snow Goose, Common Tern) and event_year >= 2018. This is the frozen input h5n1/sources/usgs_bird_banding.py reads; the full raw corpus was not archived since this project only ever uses this subset.
